adds.title: Ministry of Public Health and Social Welfare Resolution 695 (Resolucion 695), October 2016
adds.summary: In October 2016 Paraguay's Ministry of Public Health and Social Welfare Resolution 695 established that trans persons may use their social name in clinics.

adds.title: Law 7018 on Mental Health, Article 3
adds.summary: Paraguay's Law No. 7018 on Mental Health of 15 November 2022 establishes in Article 3 that mental-health care is governed by non-discrimination on grounds including sexual orientation and gender identity and that in no case may a mental-health diagnosis be made solely on the basis of sexual choice, sexual orientation, or gender identity.
